name: Unholy Hunter
description: "Unholy Hunter" is Greg Porn at his darkest — and right now it exists only as a two-minute reference statement, Ref 1.0, awaiting its final mix and artist clearance. What the reference already makes clear: this is dystopian, aggressive underground hip hop, a dangerous record whose title does its own forecasting. Greg Porn stalks the beat with predatory confidence, and somewhere in the run there is a shout-out to Black Lansky — a reminder that the CWI machine is in the room even when the track is at its most feral. The raw reference form only sharpens the effect: no polish to blunt the edges, just nocturnal menace and a trap-leaning, bass-heavy low end that feels like pursuit. When the final mix lands, "Unholy Hunter" will sit as the darkest chapter in Greg Porn's catalog run — the companion piece to "Pay Yourself"'s discipline and "On Edge"'s tension. For now, it is a two-minute warning shot from an artist hunting at full throttle.
